upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: alpha.1 moves shipped Agent presets into the preset package with includeShippedRoot, renames code mode to ptc, adds durable preset/tool-change and model-selection projections, replaces ApiProxy with Remote gateway/controllers, splits the client runtime, adds Models provider-card slots, exact per-turn usage, configurable subagent models, experimental Agent Teams, packed Session transport, Web auth, SSRF-safe public WebFetch, and terminal/process fixes. It directly improves the codex-app-server system-preset route and can replace the standalone Codex account-card placement, but it does not provide per-preset model catalog filtering or a main-session Codex App Server backend. Aezy client packages and RPC tests require a deliberate Remote/controller migration before runtime adoption.
